subject: Post-demo recap: procurement route options & security gating
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Monroe <lisa@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:20:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo recap: procurement route options & security gating

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement path and the outstanding security items you flagged.

Key points from the call:
- Preferred commercial routes discussed: PO (central procurement) vs card (pilot team card) vs listing on BrightPath internal marketplace.
- Security gating: SOC 2 Type II report, signed DPA, and a short security questionnaire the infra team needs completed.
- Timeline: BrightPath aiming for procurement decision mid-September if the SOC2/DPA check is green.

Proposed next steps (action items):
1) Ill attach the current DPA and our SOC 2 summary here for your security team to review.
2) Can your procurement team confirm whether they need a PO (purchase order) or if theyre OK paying by corporate card for an initial 3-month pilot? (This drives billing flow & contracting timeline.)
3) Monica — can you share the short questionnaire template we agreed to send? Ill route that to Lisa.
4) Lisa — if marketplace procurement is interesting, let us know so we can pull marketplace listing requirements; otherwise wel continue paper flow.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf, SOC2_Type2_2025-summary.pdf

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Lisa Monroe <lisa@brightpath.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightpath.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: procurement route options & security gating

Thanks, Priyom — helpful recap.

A few quick clarifications from procurement/security:
- Procurement: For pilots under $50k we usually allow CC; anything above that requires a PO and a legal review. The pilot scope you described looks like it could be under threshold but well confirm after SOW/pricing.
- Security: Our security team needs the SOC 2 report and a completed questionnaire. The DPA is on our legal team's checklist but were OK starting review in parallel.

Action on our side:
1) Ill confirm budget owner and whether the pilot will be card-approved by EOD Thu.
2) Ive copied procurement so they can confirm PO requirements and lead time.
3) Please send the security questionnaire and an exportable Excel version; our security team prefers to import the answers into their GRC tool.

Lisa Monroe
VP, Platform Engineering | BrightPath AI
lisa@brightpath.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Monroe <lisa@brightpath.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 15:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: procurement route options & security gating

Lisa — attaching the questionnaire in XLSX so its easy to import. Couple of notes:
- The questionnaire has three short sections: infrastructure ops, data handling, and access controls. We marked baseline answers where possible to speed review.
- If your team prefers, we can schedule a 30-min walkthrough with our security engineer to go through any questions line-by-line.

Attachment: BrightPath_Security_Questionnaire_2026.xlsx

Next steps from us:
- Priyom: I recommend we confirm whether they want marketplace (we can fast-track listing) or paper PO path. Marketplace reduces procurement friction but requires a procurement admin to enable charges.
- Ben: can you prepare a one-page SOW estimate that keeps the pilot under $50k so they can opt for card payment if they want a fast start?

Monica Patel
Sr. Security Solutions | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Monroe <lisa@brightpath.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 13:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: procurement route options & security gating

Lisa / Priyom — sending a short SOW estimate for the pilot (separate attachment via DocuSign link) that keeps initial spend ~ $32k to stay inside typical card thresholds. Key points in the estimate:
- Pilot term: 90 days, capped token usage and a clear overage policy.
- Deliverables: integration support, two model variants for evaluation, one-on-one onboarding session.
- Cancellation: 30-day notice after pilot.

Related links: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/12345abcde (SOW + signature)

Ben Carter
Commercial Lead | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Lisa Monroe <lisa@brightpath.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 11:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: procurement route options & security gating

Thanks all — quick update from our side:
1) Procurement confirmed they can approve a corporate card for a < $50k pilot; they just need the SOW and the DPA on file.
2) Security completed a quick pass: SOC2 summary looks OK, theyre importing the XLSX now. A deeper review may follow but not blocking procurement today.
3) Marketplace: were not ready to use internal marketplace for this team yet. Paper/card flow preferred.

Next steps agreed:
- Ben: finalize the SOW and send the DocuSign envelope to procurement@brightpath.ai (wel sign once DPA is uploaded).
- Priyom/Monica: stand by for any follow-up security questions; we may ask for sample audit logs if the deeper review proceeds.

If we can get the signed SOW and DPA uploaded by next Tue, were aiming to start the pilot the week after.

Lisa
